outputs: evaluation-result.json (after automatic D6 completion or a matching supplied D6 record)
evaluation-not-completed.json (infrastructure faults or explicit diagnostics-only execution)
vlm/ (bounded pair requests, raw responses, resumable checkpoints and faults)
candidate_failure_policy: Every returned candidate has numeric D1-D6 scores. Candidate build/start/crash/timeout/provider/state/capture failures become fail or unreachable with checkpoint zero. Evaluator or host faults produce evaluation_not_completed and no score row.

exit_codes.0: diagnostic result written; candidate failures may be present
exit_codes.nonzero: evaluator packaging, contract, or scorer failure
